attestation: Role attestation by evaluator; file SHA256 identifies this receipt, not a cryptographic signature.

fixed_protocol.CPU_to_Metal_plan_difference: Only backend differs; all28 call identities/order, model pins, WAV/decoded-f32 pins, decoder configuration and scoring references remain identical to accepted CPU harness002.
fixed_protocol.human: 12 scored clean English utterances,279 reference words; all complete/nonempty; microWER<=0.10 and every scored warmRTF<=1.0. Each human profile has one separate warmup.
fixed_protocol.synthetic_v2: One cold and one warm call; warmWER<=0.10 and warmRTF<=1.0; cold diagnostic only.
fixed_protocol.normalizer: Original strict Rust Unicode lowercase, retain alphanumeric or whitespace characters, then split_whitespace; no number expansion. Frozen references are passed only to the separate weight-free scorer, never the decoder.

independent_read_only_checks.WAV_and_decoded_input_details: Each frozen WAV independently hashed from immutable bytes, verified mono16kPCM16 and exact sample count, and independently reconstructed as PCM16/32768 f32 little-endian bytes matching the planned decoded-input SHA. No playback or inference.

source_control_review.cleanup_fix: managed catches cleanup/reap/drain/close errors and retains explicit cleanup_error, primary timeout/cancel reason, observed rows and raw logs. Unknown reaping or cleanup failure cannot yield complete/pass. execute tracks attempted profiles: unavailable receipts yield may-have-started uncertainty, while untouched later profiles stay unrun.
source_control_review.late_output: Unconsumed raw output remains retained but is never retroactively scored. A launch does not prove unobserved calls were unrun.
source_control_review.network_and_write_boundary: Same-binary loopback control and sandbox denial controls are retained; every actual profile repeats the canary before Transcriber::load. Runtime deny-network policy also denies writes to corpus/model/fixture roots. It is not a claim that every repository path or all compilation is sandboxed.
source_control_review.input_binding: WAV hash and decoder use the same bounded immutable buffer. Model files are length/hash checked before/after load and after profile; the source explicitly scopes privileged external ABA protection out.
source_control_review.actual_device_guard: The compiled feature selects Device::new_metal(0) with error propagation; worker requires the versioned actual Metal backend. There is no CPU fallback in the reviewed load path.
source_control_review.native_and_timing_scope: Metal MSL compilation is lazy. Whole ASR API walltime includes CPU frontend, native pipeline work needed by that call, graph execution, synchronization/readbacks, greedy selection and tokenizer; load walltime is separate. Native OS/framework versions are captured, but this is not pure GPU kernel timing or independently identified proprietary driver bytes.
